4. Rate your experience with the level.

- creator_belief: Who do you think designed this level? (choose one of: AI-generated, Human-designed)
- confidence_level: How confident are you in your answer? (choose one of: 1, 2, 3)

- enjoyment: It was fun to play. (Measures the fundamental enjoyment and fun of the gameplay.)
